id: title:JakeRuth:clarify learn file syntax and recovery

review.posthog_relevance: Adds recovery guidance and input validation to PostHog's MCP skill execution and command-line parsing, potentially helping users recover from incorrect command syntax or invalid skill identifiers.
review.reason: The observed changes are localized maintenance and behavior corrections. P1.F4.H1 adds a recovery hint to the skill manifest output, while P1.F2.H1 adds checks to reject invalid CLI flags and skill identifiers with recovery guidance. These represent bounded improvements to command-line parsing and recovery, not broader systemic capability or unverified benefit.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on users encountering these specific syntax errors, which is not demonstrated by the code alone. No production incident or adoption data is available.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a recovery hint to the skill manifest output, instructing users to use the new command syntax.
